title: Design System: GrowForge Digital AI OS

heading.purpose: All h1-h6, card titles, section headers. Tracked -0.01em.

body.purpose: Body copy, UI labels, long-form job/plan output.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Default confident-lift hover on buttons and cards.

motion.name: node-pulse
motion.value: 2.4s ease-in-out infinite, scale 1 to 1.15, opacity 0.55 to 1

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority action in a view — approve, send, launch.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0078ff, #ffc432); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px rgba(0,120,255,0.35); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4da2ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-priority action — cancel, dismiss, secondary choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #475569; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(11,18,32,0.08); transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #0b1220; border-color: rgba(0,120,255,0.4); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: The standard floating panel used across every dashboard section.
components.html:
Card title

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid rgba(11,18,32,0.08); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset, 0 12px 32px -20px rgba(11,18,32,0.25); } .ds-glass-card-title { font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #0b1220; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-glass-card-body { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #475569; margin: 0; }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: Live status indicator — pulses when active.
components.css: .ds-status-dot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0078ff; } .ds-status-dot--active { animation: ds-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,120,255,0.28), 0 0 24px rgba(0,120,255,0.28); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15); } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field used in forms and settings.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(11,18,32,0.08); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #0b1220; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(0,120,255,0.5); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; }

narrative.overview: GrowForge Digital AI OS reads as the bridge of a small, high-competence ship — not a marketing SaaS dashboard. A crisp navy-and-white hull carries frosted glass panels that float over it, each with a hairline metallic border and a soft blur. Electric blue is the instrument-panel color for action and data flow; gold is reserved and earned, marking premium or confirmed states only. Status is legible at a glance through small glowing dots and pulse animations rather than large banners.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass panels on a light, near-white base — never a dark app shell.
Electric blue = action/data. Gold = rare, earned confirmation.
Status conveyed by small glowing/pulsing dots and thin animated flow-lines, not color-blocked banners.
Motion is subtle and physical — soft lift, gentle scale, slow float — never bouncy or elastic.

rules.name: The Earned Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold never appears on an idle or default element. It marks something that has actually completed, been approved, or reached a premium/owner state.

rules.name: The Glass-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed by blur and a hairline border first; a heavy drop shadow on a static element is a tell that it's not following this system.

dos: Do use the electric-to-gold gradient only for the single highest-priority action in a given view.
Do pair every glass panel with a hairline metal border and soft blur.
Do use small glowing/pulsing status dots for live state instead of large color-blocked banners.
Do keep Sora for headings and Inter for body.
donts: Don't use gold as a background or decorative color on an idle/default element.
Don't add heavy drop shadows for depth.
Don't use bounce/elastic easing on any transition.
Don't introduce a second background pattern — the light glass-on-white hull is the one visual language across the whole app.
